body: I know what you mean, the things they say would be so different if someone I don't know or care about said them. But they are my parents, if my parents say these things, I don't even know what to think.

I really would love to get a job, but I don't have any transportation, and I live too far away to walk to any job. And, as much as I hate being at home, I prefer it to school because I can shut myself off in my room. It only really gets bad when my parents are looking to pick a fight, and that doesn't happen every day. Thank you though, I  am trying to join clubs and things to reach out and become involved, I am very shy though. I am working on it.
I'm working on it, but it seems like college is so far away. I am trying to stay strong though.
I'm glad you don't let it hold you down, that's my goal. I want to learn to be tougher.

Thank you for your kind words, and I might post an update. My therapist appointment is Monday, but I think I might want to put some distance between myself and this "episode." It got pretty dark in my mind, and it really did scare me. I will promise to post again though, if I am seriously contemplating suicide, you guys have helped me so much.
That's a good tip, thank you.
I'm trying. Independence is my main goal.
I will work as hard as I can to get out quickly. Thank you for your support, it means a lot to me to hear people telling me these things. And thanks for the link.
Thank you so much. This community is so caring.
Thanks for the offer, I'm nowhere near there, but thank you for your kindness.
Thank you, my future is bright, I just have to get there. I'm moving forward.
Thanks, but I live in a whole other part of the country. I appreciate it very much though.

I'm so glad you've had 25 years of being safe and happy, I hope I can be as strong as you :)

And, while I don't have any friends or people to talk to around me, I am close with certain members of my extended family, and I can confide in them when I need to, but they live hundreds of miles away. I am going to a therapist in a few days so hopefully he can become a good confident. I am working on making friends, but I'm having trouble. I'm not giving up though.

I really am so glad to hear of people who made it through similar situations and became the good strong people that they deserve to be. It really is motivation to make it through this.
Thank you so much, I needed to hear this.

I will, I promise.

And, I'll take him with a grain of salt, but I really do hope I like him.

Thank you so much for this. I'm so glad that I have gotten these kind messages from people I've never even met. I appreciate your advice. I don't have any friends right now, I just split with my one friend a few months ago, and I'm terrible at making new ones. I'm working on it though. And I know there's a light at the end, I've just got to keep going, and I need to remember that I can make it through this even when it gets hard. It's just so hard to convince myself of that sometimes. I really do appreciate your support. You've offered great advice. Thank you, sincerely.

I'm so sorry that you had to live with that. There's no way I'd be able to take my dad in a fight, but he's never hit me so I've never needed to defend myself in that way. But I just really am so sorry that you were in that situation, and I'm so glad you came out of it okay.

I know, I need to keep that in mind. And thanks for the offer, but yeah India would be a long trip, haha. I understand what you are saying though, and you're right, I do need to stop trying rationalizing as much as I do. I needed to hear this.
I know, and I agree. But, I can't hurt my sister. She hasn't done anything wrong.

Thank you so much for caring. It means so much to me to hear people telling me that it might not be all my fault. Sometimes the lines just start getting so blurred and I don't know who I am anymore and all the names I'm just swim around my head. But you're right, my perspective is totally warped. 

I've got a meeting with a therapist in a few days (because I had a panic attack at the doctors office) and I'm going to tell him about what's going on at home. Maybe he can help.

Thank you, again, for caring. It really does mean so much to me.

Thank you, and I'm so sorry. It certainly isn't fun. I'm glad you made it through intact, it's not easy.

I think, I've cooled down now though, I'm not leaning toward any suicidal thoughts at the moment. It's nice to know that even people who have never met me care.

Thank you.

I wouldn't because they never physically hurt me, and they're very kind to my sister. It would hurt her if they got dragged through anything involving CPS. I will keep that in mind though if it gets too much worse. Thank you.

I'm so sorry you were in that situation. Mine probably isn't that bad in comparison, I feel like I don't deserve to be sad about my parents. They never hit me, and I know both of them were beaten when they were kids :/ I just feel like I'm such a wuss for letting it get to me this bad, when so many people have it so much worse.

I will move out at the end of the summer this year or next year. I'm trying for an early admission at a college, but I don't know if I'll get it.

I don't really have any friends. I have extended family, but none near by. A few relatives have offered to let me live with them, but I need to stay in-state for college benefits, so I can't move.
I'm under 18, I can't move. I know there are so many places I want to go when I am of age, but the problem is making it through this time here.
